study.question: Does the remaining full-action versus mask-signature click-AUC gap survive common zero initialization of the action embedding table, eliminating arbitrary categorical row initialization as an explanation?
study.hypothesis: The previous signature-only shortfall may partly arise from differently initialized embedding-row assignments under a one-pass Adagrad recipe, rather than useful action information beyond the supplied masks. Zeroing only the existing action table after all inherited initialization makes every categorical action value initially identical while leaving its rows trainable. Full-action and mask-only arms can then acquire distinct representations from the same start. This tests conditional utility under the declared initialization intervention; it cannot prove information-theoretic mask sufficiency or production causality.

study.proposed_difference: Four standalone variants: byte-identical full_action_control; full_action_zero_init retaining raw action IDs and zeroing only its action table once in the constructor; mask_signature_zero_init with the same zeroing and canonical four-bit signature replacing raw historical action IDs; mask_signature_zero_affine with the identical zeroing and a fixed bijective relabeling of signature rows. All table rows including padding/OOV start zero; no rows are tied or frozen thereafter, and no new learned parameters/state/RNG/forward passes are introduced. Existing native signature trials supply the other initialization cells; no redundant native signature retraining is requested.
predictions: At paired construction, all three zero-init variants have identical learned tensors and buffers; all action rows are exactly zero, non-action tensors and RNG state match the unchanged control. Given the same batch, zero-init variants have equal initial predictions before categorical gradients diverge.

If arbitrary row initialization explains the observed native mask gap, canonical and affine zero-init mask models should agree to numerical precision and their click AUC should be within 0.0001 of full_action_zero_init. This threshold is a predeclared descriptive tolerance, not a significance test.

Recovery is most informative if full_action_zero_init also remains within 0.0001 of full_action_control; losses greater than 0.0005 in both zero-init arms limit transfer to the strongest visible model. Intermediate cases remain unresolved.

If useful incremental raw-action signal survives this control, full_action_zero_init should exceed both mask-zero arms by more than 0.0001, with concordant click Logloss, subject to effective capacity and code/signature ambiguity diagnostics.

Mask canonical versus affine zero-init is a negative control for assignment sensitivity; absolute AUC disagreement exceeding 0.00001 is a trigger to audit sparse accumulation, special rows and implementation rather than select the better relabeling.
falsifiers: Mask zero-init equal or better click AUC than full zero-init falsifies a useful raw-code increment in this matched initialization/recipe; it does not establish total historical-feedback irrelevance because masks still convey feedback.

A stable full-zero advantage despite canonical/affine agreement rejects initialization-only recovery in this implementation; without proving code/signature residual support it still does not establish extra raw-code information.

Zero-action gradients failing to become nonzero on occupied nonspecial codes, action rows remaining inadvertently frozen/tied, or a collapsed full-zero utility control invalidates the intended attribution.

Unequal initial predictions, changed non-action tensors or RNG, shared action/item tables, a non-Embedding action layer, an action feature encoder, missing sixteen nonspecial rows, nonzero target action, altered masks/items, nonfinite backward or unequal parameter counts fails preflight; do not silently substitute another experiment.
alternative_explanations: Zero initialization itself may change optimization and weaken both models; native-versus-zero full-action comparison is required.

Action vocab may merge or split equal task signatures, include aliases/special tokens, or restrict supported combinations. The raw action vocabulary is unavailable locally. Per-signature code diversity and full-stream collision counts must come only from authorized open host data, never held-out outcomes.
Row-local task-signature permutation may have been identity; exactly unchanged metrics do not show a successful removal of residual action information.
Canonical versus affine native masks differ by 0.0005728945305865 AUC at the same seed; this is row-assignment sensitivity, not independent seed uncertainty.

Allocated capacity matches, but the count of active categories and special/padding gradient eligibility may differ. Report these; do not interpret an effect as information utility without qualifying effective capacity.
Floating-point embedding gradient accumulation can depend on row labels; small negative-control disagreements need numerical checks. A single fixed seed remains preliminary.
The inherited official_offline policy may expose immature delayed feedback; conclusions concern this benchmark, not point-in-time production availability.
